nodes.title: Mathematical foundation for nth derivative of sin/cos
nodes.description: Define the mathematical formula for computing the nth derivative of sine and cosine functions. The derivatives follow a cyclic pattern with period 4: sin -> cos -> -sin -> -cos -> sin. The general formula is d^n/dx^n sin(x) = sin(x + n*pi/2) and d^n/dx^n cos(x) = cos(x + n*pi/2). This allows efficient computation of repeated derivatives without applying the chain rule n times.
nodes.expected_output: Mathematical specification documenting: d^n/dx^n sin(x) = sin(x + n*pi/2) and d^n/dx^n cos(x) = cos(x + n*pi/2) for non-negative integer n. The implementation must validate that n is a non-negative integer and handle the case where the argument equals the differentiation variable.

nodes.title: Implement _eval_derivative_n_times for sin class
nodes.description: Add the _eval_derivative_n_times method to the sin class. The method signature is def _eval_derivative_n_times(self, s, n): where s is the symbol being differentiated with respect to and n is the number of derivatives. Implementation should check if n.is_Integer and n.is_nonnegative, and if self.args[0] equals s, then return sin(self.args[0] + n*pi/2). Otherwise return None to fall back to default repeated differentiation.
nodes.expected_output: Python method with signature def _eval_derivative_n_times(self, s, n): within the sin class that returns sin(self.args[0] + n*pi/2) when conditions are met, or None otherwise.
